summary: A boutique advisory positioning and WhatsApp on the page are strengths, but empty sections and conflicting numbers appear to cost you buyers.

findings.problem: The WhatsApp link appears to use 971589633865 while the footer shows +971 55 996 9994, and the Request a Callback section appears to show no fields.
findings.cost: A buyer who cannot tell which number is real or leave details may call a competitor.
findings.fix: One verified number and a working callback form.

findings.problem: Offplan properties, Featured properties, Properties for rent, International properties and Resources each appear to show only a heading and a See more link.
findings.cost: Empty sections make an advisory firm look unfinished.
findings.fix: Filled sections or removal of empty ones.

findings.problem: Menu parents such as Buy, Rent and More appear to link to #, every item under Search properties by features appears to go to /buy/, and the page appears to end with 'Patience is the master key to all problems, This may take few moments ...'.
findings.cost: Filters that do not filter and leftover loading text frustrate serious buyers.
findings.fix: Working filters and clean page ending.

findings.problem: The page appears to show no testimonials, transaction figures or named agents, the Off Plan label appears three ways, and the newsletter appears to have no email field.
findings.cost: Luxury buyers want proof and people, and find none.
findings.fix: Named advisors, results and a working newsletter form.

redesign: One verified number, callback form and WhatsApp.
Filled sections and working property filters.
Named advisors, results and consistent labels.
